Understand what can happen to your margin and vault deposits before using FloatSheets.

{01}

Synthetic exposure, not shares.

FloatSheets offers USDG-settled synthetic equity exposure on Robinhood Chain. Positions do not give you stock ownership, voting rights, dividends, or a claim on the underlying company. The price of a tokenized stock can differ from the stock it references.

{02}

You can lose your margin.

Leverage magnifies gains and losses. A position becomes eligible for full liquidation when its equity falls below the required maintenance margin. Liquidation can include a penalty. The chart’s liquidation line is an estimate, not a stop-loss order or a guaranteed exit price. Gaps, fees, contract rounding, and delayed prices affect the outcome.

{03}

Prices and execution can be delayed.

The current price feed uses time-weighted prices from configured Uniswap v3 stock/USDG pools, signed and published to an on-chain oracle. Thin liquidity, manipulation, stale prices, or a failed publisher can interrupt trading and liquidation. These prices are not direct stock-exchange quotes. Chart candles summarize recorded oracle observations; they do not include every trade or price movement.

{04}

Vault deposits can lose value.

A shared USDG vault backs the markets. Settled trader losses can increase vault assets; winning traders draw payouts from it. LP shares have no fixed yield or guaranteed redemption value. Withdrawals depend on available liquidity after the protocol’s reserves and can fail when that liquidity is insufficient. Do not assume insurance, a bailout, or protection of your principal.

{05}

USDG, network, and software risk.

USDG can lose its peg or become subject to issuer restrictions. Wallets, RPC providers, the chain, and smart contracts can fail or be compromised. Transactions cost ETH and are generally irreversible once confirmed. Testing does not guarantee that software is free of vulnerabilities.

{06}

Access depends on service and risk controls.

A connected wallet alone does not guarantee execution. Valid signed quotes, a usable oracle, liquidity, and market limits are required. Administrative keys control important protocol settings and authorized signers; their compromise or misuse can affect users. Markets can be paused or restricted, and stock-market closures or corporate events may affect the reliability of price references.

{07}

Before you use the beta.

This is a live beta using real funds, not a simulation. Only use funds you can afford to lose. Nothing on this site is personal investment advice or a promise of returns. Review each wallet request and the current quote before signing. Report security concerns to security@floatsheets.app.
